title: Run a sprint review
summary: At the end of each sprint, the team shows what it built to stakeholders and discusses what to do next. It is a working session, not a presentation.

beginner: Invite stakeholders and some users if possible.
Remind everyone of the sprint goal.
Discuss what to do next and update the backlog.
Keep it to about an hour for a two-week sprint.
intermediate: Demo working software against the sprint goal.
Gather feedback and adjust the backlog.
Share progress towards the product goal.
experienced: Use reviews to keep stakeholders engaged and aligned.
Show results and data, not just features.
Invite real users to give feedback.

toolExamples.jira: Show the sprint report and completed items.
toolExamples.confluence: Record feedback and decisions on a review page.
toolExamples.figma: Show upcoming designs to get early feedback.
